adopted_claims.claim: Page date and issuing center attribution.
Institution describes the method as a system comprehensive factor method centered on input-occupancy-output technology.
Year-end institutional article reports May 2025 submission of national and selected main-producing-region forecasts to central leaders and relevant departments.
Institution states reference use by central and provincial departments for grain/cotton/oil trade, procurement, storage, production planning and scheduling.

limitations: Not the May original submission or proof of public release then.
No fixed six-month harvest lead time or realized procurement benefit established.
Formal equations, full variable processing and data revisions not read.
The linked National Bureau of Statistics announcement was not independently opened.
Regional below-0.22% summary conflicts with listed 2025 numbers; not adopted.
National error numbers and international rankings not used in the article.
Institutional stated use is not an implementer case or independent impact evaluation.
sources.independence: Separate collection role does not make the institutional article an independent performance evaluation; S01 and S03 are one publication.
